## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. XLK in ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02%) and VXX falling (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -16.44%) BELOW TREND are primary confirmations, with SPY (1W: +4.52% | 1M: +7.66%) ABOVE TREND and HYG (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +2.07%) ABOVE TREND providing additional confirmation.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -16.44%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND. Stocks vs Bonds rising: SPY/TLT (SPY 1W: +4.52% | 1M: +7.66% ABOVE TREND; TLT 1W: +0.67% | 1M: +0.53% ABOVE TREND) ↑ rising; Credit mixed but marginally supportive with HYG (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +2.07%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.77% | 1M: +1.64%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Neutral-to-supportive: Dollar UUP proxy showing flat weakness (1W: -0.07% | 1M: -0.80%) BELOW TREND and Yield Curve in RECOVERY (1W: +0.16% | 1M: -0.56%) → flat; TLT (1W: +0.67% | 1M: +0.53%) ABOVE TREND.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Cyclicals and Growth leading: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02%), XLF represented by Financials (1W: +3.35% | 1M: +10.92%) ABOVE TREND and XLY Consumer Discretionary (1W: +5.39% | 1M: +6.86%) ABOVE TREND; Energy lagging: XLE (1W: -3.37% | 1M: -5.22%) BELOW TREND. Style: Growth/momentum leadership confirmed by XLK/XLF strength and broad sector breadth.

**5. US vs Global?**  
EM showing strength alongside the US: EEM (1W: +5.09% | 1M: +10.56%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +3.72% | 1M: +3.87%) ABOVE TREND, while SPY (1W: +4.52% | 1M: +7.66%) ABOVE TREND remains strong; Europe signals softer via Europe vs US (1W: -1.81% | 1M: +1.08%) CORRECTION.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Appetite robust: ARKK (1W: +14.35% | 1M: +10.95%) ABOVE TREND, IWM (1W: +5.54% | 1M: +12.10%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +5.73% | 1M: +9.14%) ABOVE TREND; Speculation Index ↑ rising ABOVE TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Industrial/comms metals strong: CPER (1W: +3.96% | 1M: +10.82%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +6.59% | 1M: +7.18%) ABOVE TREND, while GLD (1W: +2.01% | 1M: +0.27%) ABOVE TREND is holding gains.

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy weak: XLE (1W: -3.37% | 1M: -5.22%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -3.77% | 1M: -12.83%) BELOW TREND; Natural gas showing short-term rebound: UNG (1W: +0.65% | 1M: -14.44%) RECOVERY.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
CONFIRMED: Broad risk-on with SPY (1W: +4.52% | 1M: +7.66%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02%) ABOVE TREND both timeframes positive. DIVERGENCES: Commodity/energy complex and select materials show weakness (XLE 1W: -3.37% | 1M: -5.22% BELOW TREND; XLB 1W: -0.15% | 1M: +7.49% CORRECTION) — classify as minor-to-moderate.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor growth/momentum exposure (XLK (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +7.53% | 1M: +22.89%) ABOVE TREND, XBI (1W: +7.13% | 1M: +14.50%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to Energy (XLE (1W: -3.37% | 1M: -5.22%) BELOW TREND); monitor credit spreads and HYG/LQD for any reversal.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Tech/Semiconductors — XLK (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02%) ABOVE TREND; SOXX (1W: +7.53% | 1M: +22.89%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: Energy — XLE (1W: -3.37% | 1M: -5.22%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Copper/Industrial metals — CPER (1W: +3.96% | 1M: +10.82%) ABOVE TREND; Silver SLV (1W: +6.59% | 1M: +7.18%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: Crude/Brent — BNO (1W: -3.77% | 1M: -12.83%) BELOW TREND; watch UNG (1W: +0.65% | 1M: -14.44%) RECOVERY for follow-through.

**13. Key Levels?**  
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold) — current VXX 28.98 (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -14.18%) BELOW TREND; Credit spread ~0.73 (current 0.7329 1W: +0.10% | 1M: +0.53%) → flat ABOVE TREND; Tech vs Financials 2.94 (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +3.78%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive.  
Tech and cyclicals showing strength (XLK 1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02% ABOVE TREND; XLF/Financials 1W: +3.35% | 1M: +10.92% ABOVE TREND).  
Key risk: commodity/energy divergence (XLE 1W: -3.37% | 1M: -5.22% BELOW TREND and BNO 1W: -3.77% | 1M: -12.83% BELOW TREND) and any widening in credit spreads to monitor.
